jei.jaymospowers.toxin_gauge: Held in a hand, or worn in the charm slot, it shows the toxin your body holds: the load with a white mark at half and a red mark where harm begins, your tolerance, the next line to cross, and any mutagens. Craft it with two copper ingots, a gold nugget, a glass pane and a spider eye.
